visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit indoor living room area, a white dog with a light-colored collar runs into the frame from the left, its body low and tail tucked, showing clear signs of distress and fear. The room features a kitchen island with various items on it and a basketball hoop mounted on the wall to the right. (2) A bare-chested man wearing dark shorts enters the frame from a doorway on the right. He immediately crouches down and extends his arms to embrace the white dog, which continues to shiver. The lighting is soft, creating a somber and intimate atmosphere as he pulls the pet close. (3) The man remains in a crouched position, holding the dog tightly against his chest while gently petting its head. The camera remains at a high-angle, static perspective, resembling security footage. The background remains consistent with home kitchen elements and dim ambient light.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大地震 Nala 快被嚇死. (2) [Subtitle]: 爸爸洗澡洗一半 趕快出來抱她. (3) [Subtitle]: 很少看到她抖成這樣. (4) [Subtitle]: 全家人都很緊張.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A piercing, high-pitched electronic siren pulses rhythmically, signaling an emergency alert. The sound has a sharp spectral bandwidth and dominates the audio track. No human voices or music are present. (2) The siren continues to pulse. A male voice enters, speaking Traditional Chinese with a low-intensity, calming, and breathy prosody. The voice is clearly enunciated but delivered at a slow rate to soothe a pet. (3) Subtle mechanical clicks and the rustle of fabric are heard as the man interacts with the dog. The electronic siren pulses consistently in the background, maintaining a high-arousal acoustic environment despite the calm vocal delivery of the speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to document and share a vulnerable, emotional moment between a pet and its owner during a natural disaster (earthquake). It emphasizes the bond of care and protection as the owner quickly abandons his shower to comfort his terrified dog.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The contrast between the high-stress emergency siren and the calm, caring actions of the man creates a strong emotional impact.
